comments.text: Release preflight 2026-07-18: v0.1.0 tag and GitHub release already exist at HEAD e0efbff; there are 0 commits after the tag. All three release workflow attempts failed only at 'npm publish --access public --provenance': npm signed provenance, then registry PUT returned E404/permission denied. npm whoami succeeds as jaggerxtrm, while npm view @jaggerxtrm/xtmux remains E404. Recovery: publish the inspected v0.1.0 tarball once with local npm auth and --access public, then configure the package's GitHub trusted publisher for Jaggerxtrm/xtmux + release.yml; do not recut/move v0.1.0.

xtmux-ro1.description:
PROBLEM: the npm registry still has @jaggerxtrm/xtmux@0.1.0, published before the j46 runtime contracts (context --json, topology, bridge, etc.) existed. A FRESH npm install therefore gets a binary that silently lacks these commands. Local machines are unaffected — they run source-linked (npm link -> the source checkout). Operator decided 2026-07-14 that source-linked is the intended install mode for now; publishing to the registry is deferred to whenever external/fresh-install consumers are actually wanted.
SCOPE: package version bump, CHANGELOG release section, npm publish (see /releasing).
SUCCESS: a fresh 'npm i -g @jaggerxtrm/xtmux' answers context --current --json with xtrm.runtime-origin.v1 and carries the full j46 surface.
NON_GOALS: changing any contract (all frozen/merged/tested).
CONSTRAINTS: npm publish is operator-authorized; never publish autonomously. Verify vendored-bun rung + files: list before publishing (see vendored-bun-runtime-rung memory).
VALIDATION: TBD — needs exploration.
OUTPUT: TBD — needs exploration.
xtmux-ro1.notes: INSTALL CURRENCY (found 2026-07-14): the source-linked install (~/.local/bin/xtmux -> npm global -> npm-link symlink -> /home/dawid/dev/xtmux) is only as current as that checkout. On 2026-07-14 that checkout sat on main at 4003abe, 6 commits BEHIND origin/main (d7c29ec) — so the installed binary lacked the bridge and the other post-.8 merges ('xtmux bridge' returned 'unknown command'). For source-linked mode to actually deliver the full epic, /home/dawid/dev/xtmux must 'git pull'. NOT done autonomously: it is the shared main checkout with other agents' live runtime state (dirty .beads/.specialists, a corrupt-* dir, bg-job files) — operator runs the pull when that checkout is safe to move. This is the source-linked analogue of the npm-registry staleness this bead tracks.
